description: Use when the user pasted a nice to have line such as "…https://nicetohave.app/g/XXXXXXXX-YYYYYYYYYY のとおりに取り込んで" and you cannot download from nicetohave.app directly (for example, a cloud session with restricted network). Checks the sign-in ticket in that link and returns the list of the kit's files and how to set it up. Then call get_kit_file for each file. 貼る文の https://nicetohave.app/g/ の住所を渡すと、キットのファイルの一覧と取り込み方を返します。

ref.description: The link from the line the user pasted (https://nicetohave.app/g/XXXXXXXX-YYYYYYYYYY), or just the part after /g/ (everything, including after the hyphen).

name: open_kit
title: Open a kit from the pasted line
